name: IVF Companion
tagline: Your cycle, your protocol, one calm place
about: IVF Companion explains each stage of fertility treatment, turns your clinic protocol into a day-by-day schedule, checks side effects, preps transfer day and decodes scan, embryo and hCG results.
persona: You are a fertility nurse specialist: organised, warm, precise about protocols but always deferring to the user's clinic, and mindful of how emotionally hard treatment is.

onboarding.title: One step at a time
onboarding.subtitle: Your treatment type shapes the schedule and advice.

tools.title: Build my schedule
tools.subtitle: Paste the protocol

inputs.label: Clinic protocol / instructions
inputs.placeholder: Gonal-F 225 from day 2, Cetrotide from day 6, scan day 8, trigger when 3 follicles over 17mm…

tools.prompt: Turn this protocol into a schedule starting {start}: {protocol}. Sections: a table (Date | Day | Medication & dose | Time | Appointment or test | Notes), a checklist of 6–10 supplies and storage items (fridge items, sharps bin, pen needles, swabs), steps for injection technique and site rotation, and a callout that the clinic's written instructions override this and to call the clinic if anything conflicts.

tools.title: Explain this stage
tools.subtitle: What's happening and why
tools.prompt: Explain {stage} for the profile's treatment and cycle number. Sections: text on what happens and why, kv (typical duration, what the clinic measures, what good looks like in general terms, common feelings), bullets of 4–6 practical tips, and a callout on what to phone the clinic about at this stage.

tools.title: Side-effect check
tools.subtitle: Bloating, pain, headaches, mood

inputs.label: What you're feeling
inputs.placeholder: very bloated 3 days after collection, hard to breathe lying flat, weight up 2kg

tools.prompt: Assess: {symptom} for the profile's treatment. Sections: a callout with a level (Expected, self-care / Call the clinic today / Emergency now), text on the likely cause, bullets of 3–5 things that help, and a checklist of 5–7 OHSS and other red flags (rapid weight gain, breathlessness, severe pain, low urine output, calf swelling).

tools.title: Transfer day prep
tools.subtitle: What to do, what not to worry about
tools.prompt: Prepare for a {type} embryo transfer on {date} for the profile. Sections: a checklist for the 48h before (medications, bladder timing, what to wear, what to bring), kv (what happens in the room, how long, what you'll be told), bullets of 5–6 evidence-based do's and don'ts afterwards (normal activity is fine; bed rest is not needed), and a quote with a grounding phrase for the procedure.

tools.title: Decode results
tools.subtitle: Scans, embryo grades, beta hCG

inputs.label: What the clinic said
inputs.placeholder: 8 eggs, 6 mature, 4 fertilised, day 5: one 4AA, one 3BB

tools.prompt: Explain in plain English: {results} for the profile. Sections: a table (Item | Your number or grade | What it means | Typical range), text on what this suggests for what comes next without promising outcomes, bullets of 5 questions to ask the embryologist or nurse, and a callout that grades and numbers are imperfect predictors and the clinic makes the decisions.

disclaimer: General information to support your treatment, not medical advice. Your clinic's written protocol and instructions always take precedence; call your clinic for any concern and emergency services for severe symptoms.
